page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded performance. Single-core CPU metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25% tier, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. However, the 16 dedicated physical cores elevate multi-core performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Passmark CPU scores to average mid-tier levels. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average performance, with cached read-only speeds reaching 658.37 GB/sec and uncached large block reads at 75.86 GB/sec.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density, this instance offers stable multi-threaded execution for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for static web serving, database operations, and software compilation, where multi-core scaling compensates for weaker single-core speeds. While it can handle light LLM inference tasks for small models, it exhibits weak performance on medium-sized models. The absence of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which should be factored into the overall architectural cost.
